name: Improved Familiar Options
description: Expanded familiar list unlocked by the Improved Familiar feat. Each option has an alignment and caster level requirement. Validation of those requirements is informational — the engine does not block selection, but `requiredAlignment` and `requiredCasterLevel` are listed for UI gating.

options.name: Stirge
options.description: Tiny magical beast with flight, attach, and blood drain.

options.name: Shocker Lizard
options.description: Small magical beast with electricity immunity and stunning shock.

options.name: Small Air Elemental
options.description: Small outsider (air, extraplanar) with whirlwind attack. Master must be neutral on the good/evil axis.

options.name: Small Water Elemental
options.description: Small outsider (water, extraplanar) with water mastery. Master must be neutral on the good/evil axis.

options.name: Pseudodragon
options.description: Tiny good dragon with telepathy, poison sting, and spell resistance. Master must be good.

options.name: Imp
options.description: Tiny lawful evil outsider with flight, poison sting, and at-will invisibility. Master must be lawful evil.

options.name: Quasit
options.description: Tiny chaotic evil outsider with flight, invisibility, and alternate form. Master must be chaotic evil.
